title: timeturner
description: add a item that will teleport you to the same world but totaly made of bedrock to have more space and make 2 bases on the same spot.
body: this mod adds a item and a new dimension. you can only enter the dimension with the timeturner item. this world mimics the real world (the overworld) but then in fully bedrock. the water does not generate and it is perfect for secret bases. or double bases.
